# Create the Release Plan

Prerequisites: the Test Plan is approved and relevant tests have actually been
run. Inspect the results; do not infer success. Read approved scope and
limitations.

Create or update only `docs/release/release-plan.md`. Record audience and
scope, readiness checklist, observed test results, verified local setup and
demo steps, data provenance/reset steps, known limitations and safeguards,
and recovery/rollback notes appropriate to the actual project. Do not claim
production readiness, regulatory compliance, or detection performance.

Leave the human release decision to the user. End with a release approval
checklist and stop.
